en.p: For a constant $a\ (a>1)$ and a positive number $t$, let $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ be the points where the curve $y=a^{x}$ meets the lines $x=t$ and $x=2t$, respectively, and let $\mathrm{C}$ be the foot of the perpendicular from point $\mathrm{B}$ to the $x$-axis. When $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=\overline{\mathrm{AC}}$ and the area of triangle $\mathrm{ACB}$ is $8$, what is the value of $a\times t$? [4 points]
